name: schedule_screen
description: Book a Google Calendar event for a candidate's screen, attach a Google Meet link via conferenceData.createRequest, invite both the founder and the candidate, and persist the resulting interview row with meet_url + calendar_event_id. Stage-advances the candidate to 'screen_done' (when round=='screen') on success. If the google-calendar connector isn't wired, fails cleanly so the operator UI can surface 'connect calendar' instead of silently doing nothing.
